# Core Rule 3 - This is a sandbox roleplaying server
Keep in character chat in character.
Keep out of character chat out of character.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Use LOOC to teach new players controls / mechanics. - Talk about mechanics through in-game means. - Talk about in-game or real-world events in pre or post game lobby.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Talk about in-game events in OOC chat. - Talk about real-world events in the game chat.
